cards.subject: a playful but soft room for a girl aged 2 to 5
cards.scene: A bright airy room with a light oak floor. A plush cream dot rug lies on the floor, with one flower-shaped blush velvet bolster pillow on it. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: a low arch-shaped blush bookshelf with a few picture books and two round lilac floor poufs (everything under 70 cm), and above it two small scalloped picture frames with soft pastel abstract art. Warm morning sunbeams from a window on the LEFT make soft dappled shadows on the floor. At the right edge of the frame, beside the mural wall, an open white door leads out of the room; a young woman in a soft cream knit sweater and light linen trousers stands in the doorway with her back to the camera, one foot on the threshold, carrying a folded blush blanket, her face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible. She stays at the right edge, well away from the mural. Palette: pastel lilac, blush pink, butter cream and light oak.
cards.framing: Shot from the right part of the room at eye level, turned about 20 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the LEFT side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with the ceiling line above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.

cards.subject: a calm room for a school-age girl (6 to 10 years) who is a figure skater
cards.scene: A bright room with a light oak floor. A plush cream rug lies on the floor; her white figure skates with blade guards stand on the rug. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: a slim light-oak writing desk (75 cm high) with a small ivory chair, an open notebook and a wooden pencil on the desk. Soft afternoon light falls from a window on the LEFT and lies evenly on the floor. At the right edge of the frame, beside the mural wall, an open white door leads out of the room; a young woman in a soft cream knit sweater and light linen trousers stands in the doorway with her back to the camera, one foot on the threshold, carrying a folded blush blanket, her face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible. She stays at the right edge, well away from the mural. Palette: pastel lilac, blush pink, ivory and light oak.
cards.framing: Shot from the right part of the room at eye level, turned about 20 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the LEFT side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with the ceiling line above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.

cards.subject: a playful retro nursery for a baby under 2 years, with scalloped edges, round shapes and soft sunbeams
cards.scene: A bright room with a light oak parquet floor. A round quilted cream play mat lies in the middle of the floor with a smooth beechwood rattle on it. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: a scalloped wooden wall shelf with small wooden animal figures (an elephant, a giraffe and a lion) and, beside it, two wavy scalloped picture frames with retro sunrise and flower prints. A playful cluster bubble chandelier with frosted glass globes hangs high in the top RIGHT corner of the ceiling, well above the top edge of the mural. Warm sunbeams from a window on the LEFT cast soft dappled shadows across the floor and the mat. A sheer cream linen curtain hangs at the extreme right edge of the frame, close to the camera and slightly out of focus, as a foreground layer. Palette: soft lilac, blush, butter cream and light oak.
cards.framing: Shot from the right part of the room at natural eye level, turned about 30 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the LEFT side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, from its near edge to the far corner, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part. Nothing stands in front of the mural.

cards.subject: a cheerful room for a girl aged 2 to 5, with a flower-shaped craft table, round bouclé poufs and scalloped details
cards.scene: A bright room with a light oak herringbone parquet floor. A plush cream dot rug lies on the floor. A low flower-shaped wooden craft table (50 cm high) with a wooden cup of wax crayons and an open drawing book stands on it, and next to it a stack of three round bouclé poufs in blush, lilac and butter cream (under 60 cm). On the RIGHT side wall, away from the mural: a scalloped wooden shelf with a few picture books and a small potted trailing ivy, and two wavy scalloped picture frames with retro prints. Warm golden-hour light from a window on the RIGHT makes soft long shadows on the floor. A sheer cream linen curtain hangs at the extreme left edge of the frame, close to the camera and slightly out of focus, as a foreground layer. Palette: pastel lilac, blush, butter cream and light oak.
cards.framing: Shot from the left part of the room at natural eye level, turned about 30 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the RIGHT side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, from its near edge to the far corner, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part. Nothing stands in front of the mural.

cards.subject: a calm, airy, botanical nursery for a baby under 2 years
cards.scene: A bright room with a light oak floor. A low round quilted oat-and-blush play mat with a small natural-wood baby play gym lies in the middle of the floor, with a folded pale sage muslin blanket and one soft cream rabbit on it. On the RIGHT side wall, away from the mural: a small potted trailing plant on a low white-washed oak stool, and above it two small framed botanical line prints. Soft afternoon light falls from a window on the RIGHT and lies evenly on the floor. A young mother in a soft oat knit cardigan and light linen trousers kneels on the play mat with her back to the camera, one hand resting on the play gym, her face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible. Palette: soft lilac, blush, ivory, pale eucalyptus green and light oak.
cards.framing: Shot from the left part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the RIGHT side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.

cards.subject: a cosy reading corner for a school-age girl (6 to 10 years) who is a figure skater, with a globe, a cork pinboard and a big floor cushion
cards.scene: A bright room with a light oak floor. A round cream wool rug lies on the floor. On the rug an oversized textured blush linen floor cushion with an open illustrated atlas on it, a classic globe on a turned solid-wood stand (60 cm high) beside it, and her white figure skates with blade guards next to the cushion. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: a natural cork pinboard with watercolour sketches of ice-rink swirls and petals, and below it a small oak wall shelf with a brass task lamp. Soft afternoon light falls from a window on the LEFT. A girl of about eight in a cream hoodie and light trousers stands beside the blush floor cushion with her back to the camera, looking down at the atlas, her face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible. Palette: pastel lilac, blush, ivory, light oak and a touch of brass.
cards.framing: Shot from the right part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the LEFT side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.

clips.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. A young woman in a soft cream knit sweater and light linen trousers at the right edge of the frame turns away from the camera and steps out through the open white doorway, then pulls the white door closed behind her with a soft natural motion until it is fully shut. Her face is never visible to the camera, not even in profile: only the back of her head, her hair and her clothes are seen. She stays at the right edge of the frame, far from the painted figure skater, and never passes in front of the mural. The warm light stays constant.
